MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable fits a concrete use for my computer or Raspberry Pi: connecting to a display with more reach than my previous six-foot cable.",
    "Recognizing my interest in connection accessories makes sense given my HDMI cable, USB extension, Ethernet adapter, and Ethernet cable purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Streaming sticks, Echo speakers, and a smart plug do not address the computer setup and workspace needs reflected in my recent purchases.",
    "My desk headphones do not establish a need for wireless sport earbuds, and my wired networking purchases do not imply that I have a Wi-Fi coverage problem.",
    "The SSD relates to my computer interests, but buying memory cards does not establish a need for a 4TB internal drive or confirm that it would fit my equipment."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been treated as interest in streaming, voice assistants, and home automation.",
    "Past headphone and storage purchases seem to have been interpreted too broadly, overlooking differences in use, connection type, and capacity."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchases cluster around wired connectivity, desk organization, equipment cleaning, and practical computer accessories.",
    "Useful additions need a specific purpose and compatible equipment; owning related hardware alone does not mean I need another device or an upgrade."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my electronics interests but largely missed my current focus on practical computer connections and workspace upkeep."
}
